summary: Nightly: Method + Wowhead refetched, 0 of 160 letters moved; WCL raid bracket back to success; Mythicstats 1082 update; 4 izen metaNotes + 3 12.1.5 takes; Archon walled.

sources.detail: All six registered pages are Cloudflare-blocked from this runner. One bounded direct GET per page with the full browser header set (UA + Accept + Accept-Language + Sec-Fetch-* + Sec-CH-UA + Upgrade-Insecure-Requests) returned HTTP 403 with a 5,486-byte Cloudflare interstitial ("Attention Required! | Cloudflare", cf-error blocks, Ray ID) on every one of the six URLs. No proxy, challenge solve or replay was attempted. This agrees exactly with the independent pre-agent published-evidence receipt (attemptedAt 2026-09-27T15:19:50.139Z), which records http 403 and a null resolved date for all six icyveins pages. Nothing was parsed, so no letter moved and neither `snapshot` (still 2026-09-22) nor the page-stated `published` dates (2026-08-29 / 08-30 / 09-01) were touched. Stored rows stay at 80 across both brackets, above the 60 floor.

Both registered pages fetched fresh in THIS session by direct browser-header GET, HTTP 200, 163,420 B (raid) and 170,071 B (M+). Parsed the `tier__tier <letter>-tier` blocks and resolved each entry from its `data-original-title` "Spec Class" string looked up WHOLE against the roster: raid 6/11/17/6 = 40 of 40, M+ 2/13/21/4 = 40 of 40, 0 unmatched, 0 duplicates. The M+ page carries four EXTRA tierlist blocks and they are the dungeon-difficulty ones — rejected by ROSTER MATCH, never by position (the eight names dropped are King's Rest, Ruby Life Pools, Voidscar Arena, The Blinding Vale, Den of Nalorakk, Murder Row, Temple of Sethraliss, Altar of Fangs). Era-verified from the ranking BODY, not the meta tags: both pages say "Midnight Season 2" and the raid page names The Venomous Abyss, while the stale og:/twitter: descriptions still read "The War Within Season 3" — body over title, so `seasonVerified` stays s2 on both. Page-stated dates re-read and unchanged (raid "Last Updated 10th August 2026", M+ 13th August), matching the independent published-evidence receipt exactly. 0 of 80 letters moved.

All six registered pages fetched fresh in THIS session by direct browser-header GET, HTTP 200, 76,399-346,574 B each; no r.jina.ai (dead on wowhead.com/guide/* since 2026-08-03). Parsed the documented way: unescape `\/` across the whole document first, then take the `[tier-list=rows]` block (exactly one per page, so no decoy `printHtml` to choose between) and match `[tier-label …]<letter>[/tier-label]` with tolerant whitespace, resolving `[spec-badge=<spec>-<class>]` kebab slugs. Per-page counts printed and reconciled: raid DPS 27/27, raid Healer 7/7, raid Tank 6/6, M+ DPS 27/27 (including the A+ band), M+ Healer 7/7, M+ Tank 6/6 = 80, 0 non-roster badges, 0 duplicates. Era-verified from each page's own headline and ranking body ("Midnight Season 2"; Devourer present on both DPS pages) — the "12.1.5" hits are the site's PTR data-tree switcher and the "Season 3" hits are user comments about Dragonflight, neither a season signal, so `seasonVerified` stays s2. Each page's JSON-LD `dateModified` re-read into `published` (raid 08-31 x3, M+ DPS 08-28, M+ Healer 09-10, M+ Tank 09-01), byte-identical to the independent published-evidence receipt. 0 of 80 letters moved.

This session independently probed all six registered tier routes with the full browser header set: HTTP 403, 6,084-6,159 B, `<title>Just a moment...</title>`, and `__NEXT_DATA__` absent from every response, so no `tierList` could be parsed. No challenge was solved, replayed or proxied. Per the owner-confirmed 2026-09-05 retention decision the last verified S2 letters stay in the consensus at their original 2026-08-25 date: 80 stored rows, above the 60 floor, unchanged.

Fetched successfully but upstream has not re-snapshotted, so the coverage date cannot advance and this is not a success. Both JSON API calls returned HTTP 200 with two plain curls, no headers, proxy or auth, and the HTML prerender was never touched: `manifest.json` (353 B) reports `snapshotDate` 2026-09-15 for the fourth run running, and `rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json` (162,376 B, `Last-Modified: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 09:45:45 GMT`) was still fetched and DIFFED rather than short-circuited on the frozen snapshotDate — the 2026-08-04 incident where a pinned manifest hid 40 moved values. 44 blocks; whitelisting `categoryType` in {dps,hps,tank} PLUS `sortField === "lowerBound"` PLUS `keyRange === undefined` gives 27+7+6 = 40 rows, 0 unmatched (`melee`/`ranged` are subsets of `dps` and are excluded by the whitelist rather than by blacklisting "dungeon"). Compared at the stored 1-decimal precision before judging movement: 0 of 40 `lowerBound` values, 0 of 40 `n` (`numberOfCharacters`) and 0 dates moved. Merged anyway per the no-change-detector policy; specs.json is byte-identical for this series. `asOf` is the source's own snapshotDate, never today, so coverage stays 2026-09-15 — 12 days old, past `maxAgeDays` 8, and that heartbeat red is the honest signal.

Collected by the trusted pre-agent `fetch-stable-metrics.mjs` step, not by this agent: `metrics-fetch/evidence.json` (checkedAt 2026-09-27T15:18:37.659Z) records status `success` with all three meta pages HTTP 200 on the first attempt (71,302 / 42,311 / 40,911 B), a complete 27 DPS / 7 Healer / 6 Tank = 40-row parse, 0 omitted specs, and `sourceAsOf` 2026-09-17 read from the pages' own `<time datetime>` (`dateBasis: source-time-datetime`), not from the rendered "Updated N hours ago". Merged `metrics-fetch/updates.json` alone through apply-metrics.mjs — no second parser was written agent-side — and all 40 values are identical to stored. The source's own date did not move and is 10 days old, so the coverage date cannot advance: 5 days past `maxAgeDays` 5, which the heartbeat reports. `check-stable-metrics.mjs` passes against the trusted receipts and git HEAD.

All 27 DPS specs requested from `chart/get/talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk/…` with up to 3 attempts each. 24 returned charts; 3 returned the 76-byte `{"status": "error"}` body on every attempt — Balance Druid, Augmentation Evoker, Devastation Evoker, the same set absent since the 2026-09-03 wholesale MID2 adoption and the same three SimC has no MID2 profile for, so upstream absence rather than a parse failure. `simc_settings.ptr` compared explicitly against the STRING "0" (truthy in JS); `simc_settings.tier` read off each chart and never hard-coded — MID2 on all 24, so the pool stays tier-uniform at 24 profiles and `SIM_TIER_REQUIRED` is satisfied. Target maps taken as `data[MID2][<n>]`, which is ALREADY best-build and a bare number: all 24 carry counts 1/2/3/5/8/15 (a first pass that treated the value as a per-build object produced 24 empty merges and was caught by printing the counts). `asOf` per chart from its own `timestamp`, never the run date: all 24 read 2026-09-23. The 12.1.5 wholesale-adoption hold does not fire — `PHASES.livePatch` and `LABEL_FLIP_DUE` are both null, and this run's own evidence has 12.1.5 still PTR-only (Wowhead's data tree lists live 12.1.0 against PTR 12.1.5; the official thread 2344395 is titled "PTR Development Notes") — so current charts merge normally. Pre-merge diff: 0 of 24 profiles moved on any target count. 24 rows clears the 15 floor with no row drop; coverage correctly does not advance, 4 days old inside `maxAgeDays` 8.

`MID2_Raid.txt` fetched HTTP 200, 1,445,728 B, and it HAD a `DPS Ranking:` block, so the HTML fallback (and its burst/DTPS-chart misread) was not needed. Era-verified off the header BUILD string, never the visible Highcharts version: `SimulationCraft 1210-01 for World of Warcraft 12.1.0.69933 Live (hotfix 2026-09-24/69933, git build HEAD e25bc40189, no-networking)` — the git HEAD advanced from the stored run's a69b06905b on the SAME WoW hotfix build, i.e. a new sim run rather than a new game build, which is the honest explanation for the movement. 45 ranking lines, the `Raid` aggregate row skipped, mapped by LONGEST PREFIX with a hyphen allowed (what keeps `MID2_Demon_Hunter_Devourer_Void-Scarred` and `MID2_Death_Knight_Frost_Rider` on the right specs) to the best hero variant per DPS spec: 24 of 27, the 7 unmapped lines being exactly the tank builds (both Blood, both Prot Paladin, Prot Warrior, Brewmaster, Annihilator Vengeance) and the 3 absent specs being Balance Druid, Augmentation and Devastation Evoker. All 24 values moved and every move is sim noise — largest Windwalker +0.17%, everything else inside ±0.15%, nowhere near `maxValueMovePct` 0.6, so no ack is needed. `asOf` stays the report's own hotfix date 2026-09-24, not the run date, which is exactly why this is `partial`: 3 days old, inside `maxAgeDays` 10.

Collected by the trusted pre-agent `fetch-stable-metrics.mjs` step; the receipt records status `success`. `https://mythicstats.com/period/latest` resolved to `https://mythicstats.com/period/1082` at HTTP 200 (202,542 B) — the same weekly period as last night, still updating inside the week. Shape checks are what tell the representation SHARE column from the `/meta` per-key-presence widget: parsed role subtotals Ranged 28.2 / Melee 31.8 / Tank 19.9 / Healer 19.9 against the page's printed 28.2 / 31.8 / 20 / 20, whole-series sum 99.8. 38 rows landed (25 DPS / 7 Healer / 6 Tank). The site publishes no update timestamp, so `sourceAsOf` is null and `dateBasis` is `observed-undated-source`: 32 changed rows take the fetch date 2026-09-27 and 6 identical rows keep their 2026-09-26 date, which advances coverage to 2026-09-27. Two specs are absent from this period's chart: Mage|Fire, whose row was already retired on 2026-09-26 and so has no stored share to strand, and Evoker|Devastation, whose stored share sits at or under the 0.5-point `MYTHICSTATS_RETIRE_MAX_SHARE` bound, so `updates.retire` removed exactly that one row (38 remaining, above the 25 floor, a 2.6% drop against `maxRowDropPct`) instead of writing a fabricated zero or silently redistributing its share. Devastation now renders blank and returns by itself when a later period prints it. Merged `metrics-fetch/updates.json` only; `check-stable-metrics.mjs` passes. ⚠️ The other half of the retirement rule fired in the OPPOSITE direction the same night: Mage|Frost, retired on 2026-09-26, is PRINTED again by this period at 0, so the trusted collector re-lands its row at 0 with the fetch date and it returns by itself — which is why the series is 38 rows rather than 37 after a retirement. Nothing agent-side chose either move; `check-stable-metrics.mjs` re-derives the required set from git HEAD and accepts exactly it.

All four official channels swept and nothing new to log. (1) The trusted official-note receipts (`official-notes/evidence.json` / `pending.json`, checkedAt 2026-09-27T15:18:41.706Z) report both configured sources `success`: the live hotfix compilation (topic 2336376) is post 1 revision 49, updatedAt 2026-09-25T17:19:59.285Z, and the 12.1.5 development thread (topic 2344395) posts 1/4/5 at revisions 3/1/1 — every post bodySha256 and every one of the 118 + 10 class-section outline hashes is byte-identical to the committed ledger, so all prior resolutions carry forward (live-hotfixes 20 applied / 98 irrelevant plus 27 irrelevant removed-section tombstones; ptr-preview 10 applied) and there are ZERO unresolved sections. The reconciled ledger was written to `data/official-notes.json`, whose only diff is the two `checkedAt` stamps; `check-official-notes.mjs --base=HEAD` passes. (2) Wowhead news RSS fetched HTTP 200 (168,912 B), parsed per `<item>` block: 40 items spanning 2026-09-23 to 2026-09-27. The only live 12.1 tuning items are the September 24 and September 23 hotfix round-ups (news=383108, news=383075) and BOTH are already logged as the 2026-09-24 and 2026-09-23 feed entries. (3) The news INDEX was polled as well, because it leads the RSS within a run: `data.news.newsData` page 1 (20 posts, newest id 383078 at 2026-09-27 09:00) adds nothing the RSS did not have. (4) The Wowhead blue-tracker JSON payload (`data.blueTracker.default`, 50 entries / 34 unique topics) was swept for standalone blue posts per step 3b: the newest class-relevant entries are the same hotfix compilation (Linxy, 2026-09-25 12:20) and the 12.1.5 PTR development notes (Linxy, 2026-09-22 16:31), both already accounted for. The 12.1 PTR forum thread 2317811 was fetched as Discourse JSON (407,497 B): 13 posts, highest 19, last posted 2026-07-31 — closed as expected for a finished cycle, not a lost thread. NOT logged, deliberately: the "WoW: Forever" beta development notes and class-tuning datamines that dominate this RSS window (news=383095, 383092, 383093) are a Classic-family product — their bodies name Season of Discovery runes, Dire Bear Form and Campfire buffs and mention neither Midnight nor 12.1 — so they are outside this tracker's scope entirely and no forecast cycle exists to log them against; and no new 12.1.5 PTR build, hotfix round or consolidated patch notes appeared this window (`PHASES.ptr` stays null, so any that had would go in the run report and log.md rather than into `data/ptr-builds.json`). No feed entry was added, no `spec.ptr` writeup was touched, and no set bonus changed, so the tier-set upkeep gate has nothing to catch up to.

All 44 unique YouTube channel feeds behind the 79 configured transcribable creator entries polled (76 class-scoped entries plus the 3 `generalCreators`; most creators are registered under several classes and share one feed), up to 3 attempts each with backoff: 44/44 HTTP 200, 0 feed errors, and the 40 `transcribable: false` reference-only entries correctly skipped. Transcripts: `transcript-fetch/summary.json` verdict `review-required`, 2 of 3 requested fetched natively (`peDmFfrUZeg` 449 chunks, `GWaPC3CyfwI` 336), 29 counted requests in the 30-day window with no configured limit; `QsYJEKOp-dA` (Tactyks) came back `review-required` on a request-timeout that may have consumed a provider request, so it STAYS in `videos[]` with its state untouched and no replacement was fetched. This agent made no YouTube or transcript-API request of any kind. Both fetched transcripts were read in full and distilled, and each was verified claim-by-claim against its own timestamps: izen `peDmFfrUZeg` -> 4 M+ `metaNotes` (Unholy DK positive, Guardian Druid positive, Elemental Shaman mixed, Blood DK mixed), superseding his 4 same-lens notes from 09-22/09-23; Dalaran Gaming `GWaPC3CyfwI` -> 3 `takes` inside his registered scope (Outlaw buff, Subtlety mixed, Restoration Druid buff), all carrying the "12.1.5 PTR preview — NOT LIVE" framing because the patch is not released, with Devourer DH, Holy Priest and Protection Warrior deliberately NOT distilled as outside his scope. Both ids were removed from `videos[]` in the same edit (the one-record precedence ladder). 2 new videos queued, keyword-filtered because the queue is drained by the metered API: izen `jBVWrW2ibOw` (the Week 6 post-tuning RAID recap, chaptered per spec) and leak `6PSzZBIDrYc` (a Survival Hunter Wildfire Bomb bug whose own description says it affects M+ and not raid). The other 219 keyword hits stay UNSEEN rather than `seen[]` — a budget cut is not a durable dismissal — and `seen[]` took nothing this run. `latest` advanced on izen and on all five Dalaran Gaming entries to the videos actually distilled. No creator opinion moved any tier, and neither video published a tier list or rank order, so `data/creator-predictions.json` was not written.

NO partition supersession was reported, so the pinned partition stands and the raid bracket waits for the reviewed switch (Mythic Kith'ix ranked entries plus parity on the reviewed bosses, on the new partition) — that is an owner recipe change, never an agent-side one. The rows were applied by the collector before this agent started; this agent holds no WCL credentials, made no warcraftlogs.com request, and neither recomputed nor edited any WCL metric row or `data/wcl-coverage.json`. These are per-encounter medians of up to 100 first-page ranked ENTRIES (entries may repeat characters), not population medians and not unique-player medians.
